name: Onago Life
source:
One morning, he woke up and found himself a woman.
He didn't know why, but he always thought women had it easier than men.
So our main character, Kimio, was thrilled. She figured a rosy new life was waiting for her.
She tried to start over and live her second life...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ125441.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
一天早上，他醒来发现自己是一个女人。
不知道为什么，他总觉得女人比男人过得容易。
所以我们的主角Kimio很兴奋。她觉得美好的新生活正在等待着她。
她试图重新开始，过上第二次人生……
